jem_summary: Collect mucus from a wet snail and change an ordinary or ghostly mucus block through humidity.

pages.title: Wet Work
pages.text: Collect mucus from a wet snail and change an ordinary or ghostly mucus block through humidity.

pages.title: Wet Work
pages.text: The mucus supports another humidity experiment and the shell tiles furnish the snail habitat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep the snail in a safe wet habitat. Ordinary mucus slows contact; soft ghostly mucus permits passage. Humidity changes these states. Removing a snail shell is unnecessary.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Keep a snail wet and collect its native mucus resource. Snails produce mucus under wet conditions; projectiles can remove their shell.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wet Snails for Mucus and manipulate humidity around Mucus/Ghostly Mucus blocks. Ordinary mucus slows contact, ghostly mucus permits passage while soft, and humidity can solidify both.
